import numpy as np

def score(item: int, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Score each bin for assigning the current item. Higher score = preferred bin.

    Args:
        item: size of the current item to assign
        bins: remaining capacities of feasible bins (all >= item size)
    Returns:
        scores: priority scores for each bin
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    return (item / bins) + (1 / (1 + np.abs(remaining % item)))

def assign_items(item_sizes: np.ndarray, bin_capacity: int) -> int:
    """Assign items to bins using the novel score function and greedy approach.

    Args:
        item_sizes: sizes of items to be assigned
        bin_capacity: capacity of each bin
    Returns:
        num_bins: number of bins used
    """
    bins = []
    for item in item_sizes:
        if not bins:
            bins.append(bin_capacity - item)
        else:
            feasible_bins = bin_capacity - bins[bins > item]
            if feasible_bins.size > 0:
                scores = score(item, feasible_bins)
                bins[bins > item][np.argmax(scores)] -= item
            else:
                bins.append(bin_capacity - item)
    return len(bins)
